note: Attic room of the rarer pronouns (dont, soi, quiconque, auquel, duquel, the -même forms). Pronouns have no gender, so no left/right rule (divider null). The narrow staircase on the far left goes back down to the conjunctions room; the white door on the far right leads to the third prepositions room. The attic has no wall board, so the room name sits on the plain wall under the round window.
